brief:
Israeli occupation forces carried out widespread demolition operations in the Farsh al-Hawa neighborhood of Hebron, according to Ma'an news agency. The scale and specific details of the demolitions were not immediately clear.

The operation is the latest in a pattern of home demolitions in Palestinian areas of the West Bank that rights groups say displaces families and restricts Palestinian construction.
title: Israeli forces demolish structures in Farsh al-Hawa area of Hebron
